States Pilot Digital Currency and 'Grain ATMs' for Ration Distribution

Kerala is set to trial 'Grain ATMs' offering 24/7 access to rations, while Andhra Pradesh plans to use the digital rupee for similar distribution. These initiatives aim to modernize and improve the accessibility of public food distribution systems.
